name: comp-255
title: Slider With Input
description: A volume-style slider with a compact number field at its end. Dragging the knob fills the track and rewrites the field, and typing in the field moves the knob to match.
use: Users mostly drag a quick value but sometimes need to type an exact number.
avoid: The number field is only about 56px wide, so long decimals or unit suffixes would clip.
a11y: Both controls have names, but they are generic: the field says Enter value rather than what it sets. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small Volume label sits above a long grey track whose left portion is solid white behind a round white knob. A narrow rounded box at the right end of the row shows the same number in centred text.
behaves: Dragging the knob grows the filled track and updates the box as it moves; typing a number and pressing Enter or leaving the box jumps the knob to that spot, and out-of-range text is corrected on blur.
customise: The label, minimum, maximum and starting value are written in the source; the field width and number format need edits.
weight: light: A single track and one small input, with no animation while idle.
